MasterDrive 8-bit machine core (milestone 1, untested on hardware).

Runs Master System, Game Gear, SG-1000 and SC-3000 software on the
MasterDrive machine model: Z80, VDP (Mode 4 at 192/224/240 lines, Game Gear
CRAM, the four TMS9918 picture modes), PSG, the FM unit (a YM2413, as
IKAOPLL) in Master System and MasterDrive modes, Sega, Codemasters and
Korean mappers, cartridge saves. MasterDrive titles run, but ESAT, the
window and text layers, line tables and unique-cell mode are not drawn yet.

ROMs go in /Assets/masterdrive/common/. The Pocket's buttons are the
console's Mega Drive pad: A = A, B = B, Y = C, Start = Start. Master System
and Game Gear games read A as button 1 and B as button 2; Start pauses
(Game Gear: Start), Select = Pause too, and Y is auto-fire for button 2
when that boost is on. To move any of these to other buttons, use Core
Settings > Controls. A docked USB keyboard is the SC-3000 SK-1100 keyboard.

Boost options in the core settings are the machine's enhancement layer. All
but True TMS colours and Start = Pause are off by default, and they
act only on Master System, Game Gear, SG-1000 and SC-3000 software (True
TMS colours also acts on MasterDrive titles' TMS9918 modes).
